items.distractor_fact: ਦੂਜੇ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਸੇ ਸਵੇਰੇ ਤਾਪਮਾਨ {D}°C ਦਰਜ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ.
items.gloss_en: In another city that same morning, a temperature of {D} °C was recorded.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different city than the one whose evening/morning temperatures the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ਉਸੇ ਦਿਨ ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਕੰਪਨੀ ਦੇ ਸ਼ੇਅਰ ਦੀ ਕੀਮਤ €{D} ਸੀ.
items.gloss_en: That same day another company's share price was €{D}.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different company than the one whose opening/closing price the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ਨੇੜਲੀ ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਝੀਲ ਦਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਦਾ ਪੱਧਰ {D} m ਸੀ.
items.gloss_en: A nearby other lake's water level was {D} m.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different lake than the one whose before/after rain levels the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਬੱਚਤ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਸੇ ਮਹੀਨੇ €{D} ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ.
items.gloss_en: Into another savings account, that same month, €{D} was deposited.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different savings account than the one whose deposit/withdrawal the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਗਿਫਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਤੇ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਵਿੱਚ €{D} ਸਨ.
items.gloss_en: Another gift card had €{D} on it at the start.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different gift card than the one whose starting balance/spend the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਮੋਬਾਈਲ ਡਾਟਾ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਸੇ ਮਹੀਨੇ {D} GB ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ.
items.gloss_en: Another mobile data plan used {D} GB that same month.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different data plan than the one whose starting/used data the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਦੀ ਇਸੇ ਮਹੀਨੇ ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ €{D} ਸੀ.
items.gloss_en: Another household's income for that same month was €{D}.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different household than the one whose income/expenses the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ਉਸੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ {D} ਗੋਲ ਕੀਤੇ.
items.gloss_en: In that same season, another team scored {D} goals.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different football team than the one whose scored/conceded goals the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ਉਸੇ ਤਿਮਾਹੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਛੋਟੇ ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰ ਨੇ €{D} ਮੁਨਾਫ਼ਾ ਦਰਜ ਕੀਤਾ.
items.gloss_en: In that same quarter, another small business recorded €{D} in gains.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different small business than the one whose gains/losses the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਲਾਈਨ ਦੀ ਰੇਲਗੱਡੀ ਦੀ ਅਸਲ ਪਹੁੰਚਣ ਦੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੀ ਰੀਡਿੰਗ {D} min ਸੀ.
items.gloss_en: A train on another line had an actual-arrival-time reading of {D} min.
items.entity_note: belongs to a train on a different line, whose own scheduled-time reading is not stated, so it carries no timetable reference to compare against

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਇਮਾਰਤ ਦੇ ਲਿਫਟ ਪੈਨਲ ਤੇ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਮੰਜ਼ਿਲ ਰੀਡਿੰਗ {D} ਸੀ.
items.gloss_en: Another building's lift panel showed a floor reading of {D}.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different building with its own unstated ground-floor reference, so it cannot be compared to the ground floor named in the question
